summary: Student-first machine candidate for Aalto University guidance and student/research guidance. Course or task instructions control AI use; separate data, disclosure, tool, and research rules apply only within their cited contexts.

dimensions.summary: University guidance allows AI support unless the course teacher says otherwise; course- or task-specific restrictions must be clear. Scope: course learning tasks.

do: Read the course or task instructions before using AI.
dont: Do not use AI contrary to the teacher instructions.

dimensions.summary: No source-backed exam-specific student rule is included here; this is not evidence of permission or prohibition.
Student guidance says to mark AI-generated content and identify the model or service, date, and generation context. Scope: student text and coursework.

do: Mark AI-generated content and cite the tool details required by the guidance.
dont: Do not present AI-generated content as your own.

dimensions.summary: Aalto AI Assistant permits public, internal, and confidential data but excludes secret, special-category, and otherwise sensitive personal data. Scope: that service, not every AI tool.

do: Check the data classification before using Aalto AI Assistant.
dont: Do not enter secret or sensitive personal data into the service.

dimensions.summary: Aalto AI Assistant is described as an official service available to Aaltonians. Availability is separate from permission for a particular course, assessment, or research task.

do: Treat the service listing as an availability signal and check the task rule.
dont: Do not infer assessment permission from an official tool listing.

dimensions.summary: Research guidance requires transparent description of AI use, rejects AI authorship, and cautions against feeding personal-data research into online AI tools. Scope: research process.

do: Describe how AI was used so the research process is reproducible.
dont: Do not list AI as an author or hide substantive use.

primary.notes: Primary author review recorded for this machine candidate; the snapshot is not a student conclusion.

secondary.notes: Independent review returned candidate metadata/copy issues; snapshot remains fail-closed.

limitations: This tracker is not legal advice, not academic integrity advice, and not an official university statement unless a linked source is the university's own official page.
This is a machine-candidate snapshot, not a student conclusion; overallStatus remains needs_review pending independent secondary review.
Scope follows the cited source role and unit. A faculty, school, department, course, assessment, library, or staff rule is not generalized university-wide.
English is canonical. Source evidence may be multilingual; no translation is provided or independently reviewed in this candidate.
A university-provided, licensed, or listed tool is not by itself permission to use it in a course, assessment, thesis, or research project.
